form.div:
Best use: Discover which catalog services are worth validating with this customer now.
Features: Evidence-based score, reason, discovery questions, selection, and draft-offering creation.
Priority: Review the reason and ask the discovery questions before selecting a service. Creating a draft starts validation only; it does not present a service or create an opportunity.
هذه توصيات للاستكشاف فقط. تحقق من الاحتياج واهتمام العميل قبل تقديم الخدمة أو تأهيل فرصة.

button.name: action_create_drafts
button.help: Create one draft offering for each selected service so the CSM can validate the need with the customer. This does not present a service or create a CRM opportunity.
Close the recommendations without creating drafts. Recommendations are calculated again from current customer evidence the next time this window is opened.
